tools.name: get_code_examples

tools.name: whats_new

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "review_databricks_code" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Check one file of SQL, Python (PySpark, a notebook's source) or YAML (a Databricks Asset Bundle, job, cluster or warehouse config) against the Field Guide's own…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guide, get_code_examples, list_chapters, review_databricks_code, estimate_cost, explore_concept, quiz_me, visualize · Private data: review_databricks_code, estimate_cost, explore_concept, visualize · Public sink: learn_path, decide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guide, get_code_examples, list_chapters, review_databricks_code, estimate_cost, explore_concept, quiz_me, visualize · Private data: review_databricks_code, estimate_cost, explore_concept, visualize · Public sink: learn_path, decide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
